name: Post Matric Scholarships to the Students Belonging to Scheduled Castes, DNH & DD
state: Dadra & Nagar Haveli And Daman & Diu
benefit: 1. Academic allowance for Day Scholars: ₹2,500 to ₹7,000 per annum. 1. Academic allowance for Hostellers: ₹4,000 to ₹13,500 per annum. 1. Reimbursement of compulsory non-refundable fees, including tuition fees. 1. Additional 10% allowance for Divyang students. 1. Students pursuing CA/ICWA/CS/ICFA are treated as day scholars. 1. Financial support for higher education and professional courses.

all.value: Dadra & Nagar Haveli And Daman & Diu

_eligibility_text: 1. The applicant must belong to the SC category. 1. The student should have passed Matriculation/Higher Secondary or equivalent examination from a recognised Board/University. 1. The applicant must possess UT domicile certificate. 1. Parent/guardian annual income should not exceed ₹2.50 lakh. 1. The students must study in institutions/colleges having an AISHE/UDISE code. 1. The participating institutions must have NAAC/NBA accreditation. 1. The Correspondence/online course students are eligible only for tuition fee support, not an academic allowance.
